blocks.text: A long time ago, a dissatisfied horse asked the gods for longer, thinner legs, a neck like a swan, and a saddle that would grow upon him. Right away, the merciful gods changed him into a creature having all the new features. But although they had looked attractive separately, the entire assembly shocked him, for he found that he had been changed into an ugly camel. “There now,” said the gods, “all your wishes are granted, and you will now live as you’ve wished all your life.” Remember! Not all change is good. You should be satisfied with what you have.

readingSentences.english: Environmental protection is no longer an option, but an urgent necessity.
readingSentences.korean: 환경 보호는 더 이상 선택 사항이 아니라 시급한 필수 과제이다.

readingSentences.english: Pollution of our oceans, air, and soil threatens the survival of countless species.
readingSentences.korean: 해양과 대기, 토양의 오염은 수많은 생물종의 생존을 위협하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Each individual must take responsibility by reducing waste and conserving energy.
readingSentences.korean: 모든 개인은 쓰레기를 줄이고 에너지를 절약함으로써 책임을 다해야 한다.

readingSentences.english: Small daily actions collectively produce immense positive changes for our planet.
readingSentences.korean: 작은 일상적 실천들이 모여 우리 지구를 위한 거대하고 긍정적인 변화를 만들어 낸다.
